items.exampleEn: The cat jumped onto the table.
He stayed throughout the whole meeting.
items.exampleZh: 他在整個會議期間都留下來。

items.exampleEn: I don't like coffee, nor do I like tea.
items.exampleZh: 我不喜歡咖啡，也不喜歡茶。

items.exampleEn: None of the students were late.
You will fail unless you study hard.
items.exampleZh: 除非你努力讀書，否則你會失敗。

items.exampleEn: Hurry up, otherwise you will miss the bus.
items.exampleZh: 快一點，否則你會錯過公車。
她不知怎麼的就完成了工作。

items.exampleEn: They marched forth into the field.
items.exampleZh: 他們向前行進到田野裡。

items.exampleEn: Meanwhile, I was reading a book.
items.exampleZh: 與此同時，我正在看一本書。

items.sentenceEn: Unless you leave now, you will be late.
items.sentenceZh: 除非你現在離開，否則你會遲到。

items.audioEn: He didn't call me, nor did he send a text.
items.audioZh: 他沒有打給我，也沒有傳簡訊。
options: He called and sent a text.
He did neither call nor text.
He called but didn't send a text.

items.sentenceEn: None of us could solve the problem.
items.sentenceZh: 我們沒有人能解決這個問題。

items.sentenceEn: I will wait here; otherwise, I will go home.
items.sentenceZh: 我會在這邊等；否則，我就回家了。

items.stemEn: You should wear a coat, ____ it will rain.
items.stemZh: 你應該穿外套，否則會下雨。

items.stemEn: I couldn't find the keys, ____ could I find my bag.
items.stemZh: 我找不到鑰匙，也找不到我的包。

items.passageEn: I called my friend Anna to invite her to a party, but she didn't answer. Nor did she reply to my text message. I waited for two hours, but none of my calls went through. I was worried that she was in trouble. Meanwhile, my brother John was making dinner in the kitchen. He asked me if I wanted to eat, and I said I would unless I heard from Anna first. Otherwise, I would just eat alone. John smiled and said, 'She probably fell asleep. She always does.' I hoped that was the case.
items.passageZh: 我打電話給我的朋友 Anna 邀請她參加派對，但她沒有接。她也沒有回覆我的簡訊。我等了兩個小時，但我的電話都沒打通。我很擔心她是不是遇到麻煩。與此同時，我哥哥 John 正在廚房做晚餐。他問我要不要吃飯，我說除非我收到 Anna 的消息，否則我就自己吃。John 微笑說：「她大概是睡著了，她總是這樣。」我希望那就是事實。

questions.questionZh: 講者為什麼沒有先吃飯？
options: 因為他一直在等 Anna 的消息
因為他哥哥沒有做晚餐

questions.questionZh: John 認為 Anna 怎麼了？

items.promptZh: 除非你現在出發，否則你會錯過那班飛機。
referenceEn: Unless you leave now, you will miss that flight.
You will miss that flight unless you leave now.
rubricZh: 正確使用 unless 引導條件從句
主句使用 will 加動詞原形表示將來的結果
語意完整，清楚表達「除非……否則……」的邏輯關係

items.instructionZh: 用 meanwhile 寫一個句子，描述兩件同時發生的事。
referenceEn: Meanwhile, my sister was watching TV at home.
He was studying, and meanwhile his mother was cooking dinner.
rubricZh: 正確使用 meanwhile 連接兩個同時發生的動作
使用過去進行式描述同時進行的事情
語意通順，能清楚表達時間上的並行關係
